finding: Alias first-known and last-seen dates must be derived from explicit provenance records rather than inferred from current salience, repository modification time, or recalled chronology.

rules: Require one or more typed source records.
Require ISO calendar dates on every source.
Bind first_known_on to the earliest source date.
Bind last_seen_on to the latest source date.
Reject records carrying raw private content.

verification.environment: isolated local Node.js execution before repository commit

inferred: Source-bound date ranges reduce false chronology and make later backfills auditable.
proposed: Attach validated provenance ranges to accepted alias records at the continuity ingestion boundary.
Backfill dates only when a repository artifact, decision log, privacy-safe chat summary, or other approved artifact supports the observation date.
superseded: Use repository file modification time as the alias first-known date.
Treat remembered or likely chronology as observed history.
